source.sourceText:
Updates progress % and logs to keep the user informed.
Formulates specific prompts for each selected deliverable, incorporating the user's config (Audience, Tone, Language, and Objective) and the raw source text content.
Makes async HTTP POST calls to the local Ollama server at http://localhost:11434/api/generate using the gemma2:2b model.
Replaces the hardcoded HTML template contents in results with the actual AI responses returned by Ollama (formatted nicely with layout HTML).
Handles errors: if Ollama is unreachable, automatically logs a warning (Ollama local server not reachable. Falling back to local offline generation simulator.) and triggers the fallback simulator so the system remains functional.

executive-summary.title: Executive Summary
executive-summary.content:
Executive Summary

This system leverages cutting-edge AI technology to transform raw data into compelling, customized content. It seamlessly integrates with a local Ollama server for real-time content generation and adapts to diverse user preferences through configurable parameters:

* **Target Audience:** The system tailors its output to specific groups, ensuring the right message resonates with each audience segment.
* **Tone & Language:** The system dynamically selects appropriate language and voice based on user requirements, resulting in professional, engaging content that aligns with individual brand identities.
* **Objective Goal:** By precisely incorporating user-defined objectives into the AI generation process, this system helps users create dynamic, impactful communication across various platforms.

**Stay informed about progress.** The system provides real-time updates on the generated content's status and incorporates relevant data to keep users in the loop throughout the process.


**Key Benefits:**
* **Enhanced Efficiency:** This system streamlines content creation by automatically applying AI models and prompts, significantly reducing development time.
* **Precision & Customization:** Users can precisely control their content's format, tone, and target audience through intuitive configuration options.
* **Resilient Generation:** In case of network issues with the Ollama server, this system offers a fallback mechanism using an offline simulator to maintain functionality and ensure consistent output.

Generated offline via gemma2:2b (Audience: General Public, Tone: Professional).

## Real-Time AI Progress Updates with Enhanced Transparency

Get instant updates on your project's progress! This system delivers **real-time** performance reports and utilizes advanced prompts tailored to your specific needs:

* **Detailed Progress Tracking:** We keep you informed with the latest progress percentages, ensuring transparency throughout the process.
* **Custom Prompts for Every Deliverable:** We formulate precise prompts based on your project configuration (audience, tone, language, objective) and source text content. This ensures optimal results that align perfectly with your needs.
* **Effortless & Efficient AI Generation:** We seamlessly integrate with Ollama's powerful model using the "gemma2:2b" version. Our system leverages a robust local server for high performance.
* **Seamless Delivery Format:** The generated content is beautifully presented within an interactive HTML template, providing a user-friendly experience.
* **Resilience & Reliability:** We're built to handle potential network hiccups! If the Ollama server encounters an issue, we automatically switch to our offline simulator and maintain functionality without interruption.

This system prioritizes both your time and your project's success.

Generated offline via gemma2:2b (Audience: General Public, Tone: Professional).
